CHRIST CONSTRUCTORS, INC CHRIST, TRYSTAN SHEN BUSINESS AND PROFESSIONAL CODE 7031 PROHIBITS A CLAIM FOR PAYMENT FOR WORK BROUGHT BY AN UNLICENSED CONTRACTOR.
